authorised_by: architect directive of 2026-08-27, point 3: the J19A manifest stays byte-identical; the correction lives in an overlay, never in place

why_the_three_consumable_keys_are_at_the.rule: warm_start._load_actor_feature_manifest reads actor_feature_names, actor_feature_count and actor_digest from the TOP level of the document (warm_start.py:155-180). A list nested under a documentation key is not consumable, however well documented.
why_the_three_consumable_keys_are_at_the.measured_not_assumed: a first draft of this overlay kept the list under a 'correction' key and was rejected at runtime with ValueError: actor feature manifest must contain a non-empty actor_feature_names list. The three keys were hoisted for that reason.
why_the_three_consumable_keys_are_at_the.the_other_two_keys_are_deliberate: actor_feature_count and actor_digest are OPTIONAL for warm_start, and both are hard-checked when present. Including them turns the transplant into a fail-closed provenance check: a manifest paired with the wrong module is refused instead of silently accepted.
why_the_three_consumable_keys_are_at_the.everything_below_is_documentation: warm_start ignores unknown keys, so the provenance travels with the artefact it describes rather than in a separate file that could drift away from it

overlays.precedent: the same treatment the architect ordered for the stale J8 leaf manifest in v26c_j18_provenance_overlay_j8_2026-08-27.json: declare, do not correct

module_under_overlay.actor_digest_semantics: warm_start.actor_state_digest over the ten WARM_START_ACTOR_KEYS, sorted; sha256 of key utf-8 bytes then the tensor digest (ascii dtype, repr of the int shape tuple, C-order bytes)

why_this_overlay_is_needed.defect: the J19A manifest carries no actor_feature_names key
why_this_overlay_is_needed.consequence: warm_start._load_actor_feature_manifest raises ValueError at warm_start.py:163-168, and warm_start.resolve_source_actor_features auto-discovers that same manifest from inside the module directory at warm_start.py:200-205. A warm-start transplant pointed at the J19A module directory therefore fails before any tensor is copied.
why_this_overlay_is_needed.measured: reproduced at runtime, with and without the explicit manifest flag: both paths raise the identical ValueError
why_this_overlay_is_needed.scope_of_the_defect: J19A's manifest is the only one of the 85 actor_feature_manifest.json files in the repository that lacks the key
why_this_overlay_is_needed.why_not_fix_in_place: the J19A leaf is committed evidence under a verified post-commit receipt. Editing any byte of it would invalidate the receipt, the commit verification and every downstream pin, including the J19B and J19C entry evidence.
why_this_overlay_is_needed.why_not_borrow_another_manifest: the J2, J8 and J15 manifests carry their own actor_digest, which warm_start hard-checks at warm_start.py:236-240. Pointing one of them at the J19A module would be refused - correctly - as a provenance mismatch.

the_feature_list.order_semantics: index i of the list is column i of the actor observation slice, which is the leading 35 columns of the 84-wide production observation
the_feature_list.names_join_semantics: sha256 of the 35 names joined by a single newline, utf-8, no trailing newline

provenance_of_the_names.rule: the names are NOT authored here. They are transcribed from committed artefacts, and the readiness preflight re-reads every source listed below and refuses any disagreement.
provenance_of_the_names.note_on_the_j8_and_j2_manifests: the J8 leaf manifest is byte-identical to J2's and is stale about its own module hash, which the architect ruled must not be corrected. Its actor_feature_names list is nevertheless one of the thirteen agreeing sources, and it is the feature list, not the module hash, that this overlay transcribes.
provenance_of_the_names.runtime_corroboration: the J19C receipt records runtime_contract.actor_feature_count = 35 and runtime_contract.observation_feature_count = 84 in every one of the three cells, and the runtime contract check reads the names off the LIVE environment, not off any manifest

the_gait_clock_columns.what_happens: with gait_clock_enable false in the pinned runtime, the transplant is asked to zero the target columns for gait_phase_sin and gait_phase_cos (warm_start.DISABLED_GAIT_CLOCK_FEATURES, applied at train_ppo_mlp.py:1784-1799)
the_gait_clock_columns.why_it_changes_nothing_here: columns 0 and 1 of the J19A pi.0.0.weight are ALREADY exactly zero at the bit level, and so are their pi_encoder.0.weight aliases. The forced zeroing is therefore a provable no-op and cannot perturb the transplanted actor.
the_gait_clock_columns.measured_not_assumed: verified directly on the J19A bytes: the two columns compare byte-equal to a zero array of the same dtype and shape
the_gait_clock_columns.corroborated_by: the J19A manifest's own clock_columns_exactly_zero field, and by the same assertion in J18, J19A, J19B and J19C
the_gait_clock_columns.the_readiness_probe_checks_it_again: check P17 of the K1 probe

fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_confir.module_state_sha256: matches the actual bytes of the module it sits beside
fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_confir.actor_digest: recomputed from the module bytes and equal
fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_confir.clock_columns_exactly_zero: true, and re-measured by this stage

fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_declar.manifest_says: reproduced and offline-eligible; closed-loop A-F NOT run
fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_declar.why_it_is_stale: true when J19A was committed, false since. J19B ran the closed-loop A-F qualification and returned PASS on 6/6 cells; J19C ran the held-out G/H/I qualification and returned PASS on 3/3 cells, 42/42 gates.
fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_declar.current_truth: reproduced, offline-eligible, closed-loop qualified 6/6 in J19B and 3/3 in J19C
fields_of_the_underlying_manifest_declar.action_taken: declared here, NOT corrected in place

what_this_overlay_does_not_do.deployable_key_deliberately_absent: the J8 and J2 manifests carry a deployable key; this overlay does not, because no stage of this chain has demonstrated deployability and J19C records promotion NONE
what_this_overlay_does_not_do.does_not_widen_the_actor: the actor stays 35D. There is no 25D variant, no widening and no contralateral feature.

how_a_consumer_must_use_it.rule: a consumer that needs actor_feature_names for the J19A module must read this overlay and must not fall back to the leaf manifest
how_a_consumer_must_use_it.j20_mechanism: the preregistered warm-up command passes this file's path explicitly, so warm_start never auto-discovers the leaf manifest from inside the module directory
how_a_consumer_must_use_it.source_config_is_deliberately_not_suppli: the J19A run directory holds no training_cfg.resolved.yaml, because J19A was an offline supervised fit and not a training run. The transplant records source_config_exists false, which is truthful; inventing a config to fill the field would not be.
